{{Top|leg}}
'''Aridinians''' were a social group. Their [[Aridinian folk music|folk music]] had, by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], become famous across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for its ability to make [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ear/Legends|ears]] bleed after a few notes.

==Behind the scenes==
Aridinians received an indirect mention in the [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'', written by [[Alex Wheeler]]. After the release of Wheeler's book, [[Aridinia system/Legends|Aridinia system]] was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'', although no explicit link has been made between the group and the system.
